items.html: And indeed, the growth of Malchut is only through the medium of ZA himself. For the upper Ima, when she grew him, gave him further a power of growth for Malchut. And afterwards this aspect of the growth of Malchut went out to the outside, through the medium of Tifferet; and then Malchut also grows to the limit of her growth, which is until she too is completed to her complete ten Sefirot.
